how_to_apply: Eligible ECoR employees must apply online through the official RRC Bhubaneswar website. A single online application is required even when applying for multiple posts.
Visit the official website www.rrcbbs.org.in and click on the ECoR GDCE 2026 application link.
Fill in personal details and bio-data carefully in the online application form.
Upload a recent colour passport-size photograph (35mm x 45mm, JPEG format, up to 100 KB) and a scanned signature (JPEG, 10–40 KB).
Keep scanned self-attested copies of date of birth, educational/technical qualification, caste certificate, and PwBD certificate (as applicable) ready before applying.
Review all entered details carefully, then click the register button - once registered, no changes can be made to the application.
Note the unique application number generated after registration and download/print the filled application in PDF format.
Get the printed application forwarded by the controlling officer and upload the signed, scanned copy under the supporting documents tab (mandatory).
Submit the application well before the closing date of 14.09.2026 to avoid last-minute technical issues.
important_instructions: Only regular ECoR employees (excluding RPF/RPSF) with lien in ECoR/erstwhile Waltair division/SCoR are eligible; resigned or transferred-out employees cannot apply. Name, Father's Name, and Date of Birth must match Matriculation/SSLC records and service records; no subsequent change requests will be entertained. A valid personal mobile number and email ID must be maintained throughout the recruitment process, as all communication is via SMS/email only - no request for change will be entertained after submission. Applications are liable for rejection for reasons including: missing Immediate Supervisor's certification PDF, incorrect educational qualification, overage, invalid/incorrect photo specifications, signature in block/capital letters, or incomplete application. SC/ST/OBC-NCL candidates must produce original caste/OBC-NCL certificates in the prescribed formats (Annexure-C, D, E) at the time of Document Verification; otherwise their candidature will be considered under the UR category if otherwise eligible. There is no separate reservation for Economically Weaker Sections (EWS) under this notification. Electronic gadgets, wallets, belts, and metallic items are strictly banned inside the exam hall. Any candidate found using unfair means or attempting impersonation will be debarred for life from all RRB/RRC examinations and is liable for legal action. Vacancies are provisional and may increase, decrease, or become nil at any stage as per Railway Administration's requirements.

content_sections.heading: ECoR GDCE Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: The ECoR GDCE 2026 notification covers 1421 total vacancies across seven post categories, distributed among UR, SC, ST, and OBC candidates as below. One post under Junior Engineer is reserved for PwBD (Locomotor Disability). A detailed division/unit-wise vacancy breakup (Khurda Road, Waltair, Sambalpur, MCS/CRW, and ECoR HQ) for each post is available in Annexure-A of the official notification PDF. Vacancies are provisional and subject to change as per Railway Administration requirements.

content_sections.heading: ECoR GDCE Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: To be eligible for ECoR GDCE Recruitment 2026, a candidate must be a regular employee of East Coast Railway (including erstwhile Waltair division/SCoR), excluding RPF/RPSF staff, currently holding lien in ECoR. Employees who have resigned or transferred out of East Coast Railway are not eligible. Employees already in the same grade/pay level as the notified post can apply for GDCE from Non-Safety to Safety posts and Safety to Safety posts; employees in a lower grade/pay level can apply for all notified categories, provided they hold the prescribed educational qualification. Educational and technical qualification requirements vary by post, as detailed in Annexure-B of the notification: Exact designation-wise qualification (all 23 individual post variants, e.g. JE/Civil-Track Machine, Technician-III/Welder/C&W) is listed in Annexure-B of the official notification. Candidates awaiting final results of the required qualification should not apply. Qualification must be held as on the date of this GDCE notification.

content_sections.heading: ECoR GDCE Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection under ECoR GDCE 2026 follows a single-stage Computer Based Test (CBT), followed by post-specific additional stages, Document Verification, and Medical Examination: There is negative marking in CBT: 1/3rd mark deducted for each wrong answer. There is no negative marking in CBAT. Minimum qualifying marks in CBT: UR – 40%, OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) – 30%, SC – 30%, ST – 25% (relaxable by 2 marks for PwBD candidates in case of shortage against reserved vacancies). Shortlisting for CBAT/Typing Skill Test is done at 8 times the number of vacancies, based on CBT merit. For ALP, final merit uses 50% weightage for CBT and 50% for CBAT. For Station Master, it is 70% CBT and 30% CBAT. Candidates equal to the number of vacancies are called for Document Verification, based on CBT/CBAT merit. Final appointment is subject to passing the prescribed Medical Fitness Test.

Visit the official website www.rrcbbs.org.in and click on the ECoR GDCE 2026 application link. Fill in personal details and bio-data carefully in the online application form. Upload a recent colour passport-size photograph (35mm x 45mm, JPEG format, up to 100 KB) and a scanned signature (JPEG, 10–40 KB). Keep scanned self-attested copies of date of birth, educational/technical qualification, caste certificate, and PwBD certificate (as applicable) ready before applying. Review all entered details carefully, then click the register button - once registered, no changes can be made to the application. Note the unique application number generated after registration and download/print the filled application in PDF format. Get the printed application forwarded by the controlling officer and upload the signed, scanned copy under the supporting documents tab (mandatory). Submit the application well before the closing date of 14.09.2026 to avoid last-minute technical issues.

faq.question: Q1. What is ECoR GDCE Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: ECoR GDCE Recruitment 2026 is the General Departmental Competitive Examination notified by East Coast Railway's RRC Bhubaneswar (Notification No. ECoR/Pers/RRC-GDCE/2026, dated 07.08.2026) to fill 1421 vacancies against 25% of the net Direct Recruitment Quota in Safety and Non-Safety posts, open only to eligible existing ECoR employees.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under ECoR GDCE 2026?
faq.answer: There are 1421 total vacancies across Assistant Loco Pilot, Station Master, Goods Trains Manager, Junior Engineer, Technicians, Junior Clerk cum Typist, and Commercial Clerk cum Ticket Collector posts.

faq.question: Q3. Who is eligible to apply for ECoR GDCE 2026?
faq.answer: Only regular and eligible employees of East Coast Railway (including erstwhile Waltair division/SCoR), except RPF/RPSF staff, who currently hold lien in ECoR, are eligible to apply.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply for ECoR GDCE 2026?
faq.answer: The online application closes on 14.09.2026.

faq.question: Q5. When does the ECoR GDCE 2026 application process start?
faq.answer: Online registration opens on 15.08.2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the qualification required for ECoR GDCE 2026?
faq.answer: Qualification varies by post, ranging from Matriculation/SSLC with ITI or Act Apprenticeship for Assistant Loco Pilot and Technician posts, to a Degree for Station Master and Goods Trains Manager, and a Diploma/Degree in Engineering for Junior Engineer posts. Full post-wise details are in Annexure-B of the notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for ECoR GDCE 2026?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 42 years for UR, 45 years for OBC, and 47 years for SC/ST candidates, reckoned as on 01.01.2027.

faq.question: Q8. Is there an application fee for ECoR GDCE 2026?
faq.answer: The notification does not specify any application fee.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for ECoR GDCE 2026?
faq.answer: Selection involves a Computer Based Test (CBT), followed by a Computer Based Aptitude Test or Typing Skill Test for applicable posts, Document Verification, and a Medical Examination.

faq.question: Q10. How can I apply online for ECoR GDCE Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Eligible employees must apply through a single online application on www.rrcbbs.org.in, upload the required photograph, signature, and certificates, and submit the printout through their controlling officer before the closing date.
